pins.name: OUTPUT
pins.notes: ECG signal. To an ADC1 pin (GPIO 32 to 39)

pins.name: LO-
pins.notes: Leads-off detect -, HIGH when an electrode is loose

pins.name: LO+
pins.notes: Leads-off detect +, HIGH when an electrode is loose

pins.name: SDN
pins.notes: Shutdown, active LOW. Can be left unconnected

pins.name: RA
pins.notes: Right arm electrode pad (also on the 3.5 mm jack)

pins.name: LA
pins.notes: Left arm electrode pad (also on the 3.5 mm jack)

pins.name: RL
pins.notes: Right leg electrode pad (also on the 3.5 mm jack)

sources.title: Analog Devices AD8232 datasheet
sources.section: Supply 2.0 to 3.5 V; leads-off detection outputs LOD+ and LOD-

sources.title: SparkFun AD8232 hookup guide
sources.section: Pins GND, 3.3v, OUTPUT, LO-, LO+, SDN; pads RA, LA, RL. Not a medical device
